user_objective: Harness and methodology that enable increasingly capable external frontier models to perform autonomous research, producing thesis evidence then ARGO prototype.
supersedes_research_focus: B/C/G graph-control comparison; old data/contracts preserved
study_object: model-external research strategy, reusable tools and experience/context use
frontier_model_weights: fixed; no pretraining, fine-tuning, distillation or RL training of frontier LLMs
task_model_training: small ML classifiers are research task artifacts, not frontier LLM development
selected_question: Can an experience-adaptive research harness improve a fixed frontier model on new ML datasets, and do frozen harness artifacts retain useful effects on another model?

candidate_competition.disposition: not headline; overlapping prior art and difficult direct user-value attribution; borrow trace-to-tools method only
selected harness method; compare to same-history notes and strong fixed tools
reserve only; source validates large SFT, not fixed-model simulator fidelity

primary_contrast: ADAPTIVE minus NOTES within each pinned model; FIXED is strong reference
model_transfer: Freeze all harness artifacts learned with reference model; run on second pinned model without target feedback or rebuilding; no universal future-model extrapolation

pilot.token_cpu_wall_caps: freeze from bounded development profiling before target outcomes; no execution authority created

measurement.primary: independently scored final balanced accuracy with explicit delivery failure and scorer-missingness reporting; do not promote valid-only means to all-assignment efficacy
measurement.cost: source experience+extraction+validation+retrieval+target work+failures; separately expose marginal reuse vs all-in cost
measurement.secondary: experiments/time to prespecified useful quality and observed break-even target count
measurement.generalization_unit: dataset/source family; seeds and models do not multiply independent dataset n
measurement.task_exposure: heldout to this study, not guaranteed unseen in model pretraining

scientific_constraints: one final artifact per target run
same base tools/evidence access and common resource accounting
do not infer independent verification from a learner self-score
neither new source/topic selection nor numerical proposal authorizes live model/compute runs
novelty: conditional empirical combination; generic scientific skills, harness evolution and model portability have prior art
falsifiers: creation cost not recovered in observed scope
prototype: Existing native substrate executes research, reuses validated external procedures and supports model selection; show actual changed experiment choice, final quality and full costs
construction_status: paused until existing resume requirements and explicit restart; no native change here
